title: Gas-Efficient Decentralized Random Beacons
venue: IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency
abstract: An untrusted dealer collects signed contributions off-chain and commits to them using a Merkle tree. Participants can challenge omissions or incorrect handling through the contract. Deadlines, deposits, and on-chain fallback operations support the incentive analysis. The construction reduces ordinary-path gas use while retaining challenge paths for deviations.
summary: Moves contribution collection off-chain and uses commitments, challenges, and deposits to reduce the on-chain cost of a random beacon.
